lesson: The transformation model and the four Vs
title: The transformation model
caption: Inputs of two kinds are changed by the process into outputs, usually a mix of products and services. The four Vs then explain why two operations that transform food and customers are designed so differently.
alt: Three boxes: inputs (transformed resources and transforming resources), the transformation process, and outputs (products and services).
description: Inputs: transformed resources (materials, information, customers) and transforming resources (facilities and staff).
Transformation process: changing physical properties, location, ownership, information or the state of customers.
Outputs: products and services, usually a mix.
